articles.availability_note: Catch-up edition: prepared for 2026-11-07; first published November 13, 2026. NASA reported the work on November 4. Its achieved flights occurred in April 2024 and on May 14, 2026; FOXSI-5 observed three small flares during the latter flight. The roughly five-minute observing window differs from the generic 5–20-minute sounding-rocket time in space. The alert estimates the location and duration of an already detected flare. Full journal methods, numerical forecast error, false-alarm rates and broad operational space-weather performance were not independently verified here.
